notes:
## Changes

- Enabled App Sandbox with only the sandbox entitlement. Direct incoming and outgoing network connections are blocked; no additional file, device, personal-data, debugging, or runtime-exception entitlements are granted.
- Kept Hardened Runtime enabled and Input Monitoring as the only requested privacy permission.
- Added CI checks that reject app bundles with missing sandboxing, excessive entitlements, or missing Hardened Runtime.
- Clarified installation, shortcut behavior, and recovery documentation.

Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later. Ad-hoc signed; not notarized. Secure Keyboard Entry may prevent the shortcut from working. Automated tests and app-bundle verification must pass before this release is published.
